results.objective: Verify 100% transactional accuracy for concurrent book reservations
results.expected: Only one user can reserve the final available copy of a book; no double booking and no negative count can occur.
results.actual: HTTP statuses = [200, 200]; reservations created = 1; book count after test = 0.
results.remark: Concurrent reservation route was executed by two authenticated users against one available physical copy.
